note: Rival Rescue Plan data (R9). Hand-written from RIVAL_RESCUE_PLAN.md + the expanded edition; edit here.

hotshot.approach: {player}! Stop right there. I've got news, and it's about to make your day.
hotshot.offer: They took {count} of yours, right? I've been scouting {site}. I've got a plan. A great plan. The best one I've ever had.
hotshot.pitch-quiet: Option one: we sneak in. I know, I know, me, sneaking. I can do it for, like, ten minutes.
hotshot.pitch-loud: Option two: we walk in the front door, I announce us, and everybody in the way regrets it. That's my pick.
hotshot.pitch-deal: Option three: we pay them off. Boring. Fine. But it works.
hotshot.accept: That's the spirit! You and me. They won't know what hit them.
hotshot.decline: Wait, what? You're turning down a Hotshot-certified plan? …Fine. It'll keep. For a bit.
hotshot.start: Right. Stay behind me. No, beside me. Okay, slightly behind.
hotshot.complication: Okay, that guard wasn't on my map. Don't look at me like that. He wasn't!
hotshot.full: Told you! Flawless! Every last one. Okay, mostly flawless.
hotshot.partial: Okay, so we got some. That's a lot, actually! We'll get the rest, I swear.
hotshot.fail: That wasn't supposed to happen. I'll make it right. I will. Give me a day.
hotshot.second-offer: I've been thinking about it. My plan's still good. Want to try again?
hotshot.climax-eve: No more waiting. They've got your Pokémon and a big show planned. We hit {site} now, or never.
hotshot.hint-approach: I'll go first and be loud. That's the plan. That's also just me.
hotshot.hint-door: Hinges! Always go for the hinges. I saw it in a film.
hotshot.hint-cage: Get in front of the cages. If anything hits them I'll never forgive either of us.
hotshot.pitch-inside: We know a guy? We *know a guy*! Why didn't you say! Okay, new plan, the guy.
hotshot.pitch-exchange: We trade them something? Like a hostage swap? That is the coolest thing you've ever suggested.
hotshot.reunion: Look at them! Look at {mon}! Okay, I'm not crying, there's cage dust.
hotshot.held-too-long: …{mon}'s got something on it. Something of theirs. That's on me. I was slow.
hotshot.the-pound: The cells are *on the map*. They put the cells on the map! I'm taking the cells.

prodigy.approach: I've been looking for you. We should speak, privately and quickly.
prodigy.offer: {count} of your Pokémon are held at {site}. I've mapped the guard rotations and the paperwork. I can get them out. The question is how.
prodigy.pitch-quiet: Plan A, extraction. Minimal contact, highest efficiency, and a roughly seventy per cent success rate if you follow instructions.
prodigy.pitch-loud: Plan B, assault. Higher variance, shorter duration. Not elegant. Effective.
prodigy.pitch-deal: Plan C, a transaction. Zero risk to the Pokémon, moderate cost to you. I'd prefer not to use it.
prodigy.accept: Good. Memorize the route. I'll lead; you improvise only when I say.
prodigy.decline: That is an unusual decision. I'll assume you have a reason. The offer stands.
prodigy.start: Stage one. Three minutes. Count them.
prodigy.complication: An unlisted patrol. Recalculating. Do not move.
prodigy.full: Every variable accounted for. Well, nearly. They're yours again.
prodigy.partial: A partial result. I will adjust the model. The remainder is recoverable.
prodigy.fail: My estimate was wrong. That doesn't happen often. I'm not enjoying it.
prodigy.second-offer: I've revised the plan. The odds are better. Will you hear it?
prodigy.climax-eve: We are out of time. Whatever the plan, it begins now.
prodigy.hint-approach: The shift changes at the quarter hour. We wait. Patience is a tactic.
prodigy.hint-door: The receipt lists a service entrance. They wrote the route down for us. Remarkable.
prodigy.hint-cage: Let it see you before you touch the latch. A frightened Pokémon is a variable.
prodigy.pitch-inside: An informant removes the Door beat entirely. I recommend it. I recommend also that we thank them properly.
prodigy.pitch-exchange: A trade is a negotiation with a fixed outcome, provided nobody talks too much. I shall stand behind you and not talk.
prodigy.reunion: All accounted for. …I had prepared remarks. I find I do not need them.
prodigy.held-too-long: There is a trace of their method on {mon}. Ten points of Corruption, by my estimate. Recoverable. I am sorry it is not zero.
prodigy.the-pound: The holding site is a district. Assign me to it. I have its floor plan memorised, for reasons I regret.

friendly.approach: {player}! Oh, I'm so glad I found you. I've been worried sick. Are you okay?
friendly.offer: I know they took {mon} and the others. I couldn't stop thinking about it. Let's get them back. Together. I've got a plan, and snacks.
friendly.pitch-quiet: We could sneak in, quiet as anything. I'll bring a lantern with a cover on it, and berries in case anyone's scared.
friendly.pitch-loud: Or we fight our way in. I don't love it, but I'll be right beside you, healing as fast as I can.
friendly.pitch-deal: Or we could pay. It's not brave, but nobody gets hurt. I'll chip in what I have.
friendly.accept: Yes! Okay! We'll bring them home. I promise.
friendly.decline: Oh. Okay. I understand. I'll be around if you change your mind. I'll always be around.
friendly.start: Deep breath. We've got this. {mon} knows we're coming.
friendly.complication: Oh no, there's someone there. Okay, okay, stay calm. I'll distract them. Sort of.
friendly.full: They're safe! They're all safe! Look, {mon}'s so happy! I'm crying, sorry.
friendly.partial: We got some of them! We'll get the others, don't give up. I won't.
friendly.fail: I'm so sorry. I really thought it would work. We'll try again. I swear we will.
friendly.second-offer: I haven't stopped thinking about it. Could we try again? Please?
friendly.climax-eve: We can't wait any longer. They're going to use them tonight. Let me help. Please.
friendly.hint-approach: Let's wait till they change over. I don't want anyone to get in trouble. Even them. A bit.
friendly.hint-door: There's a little side door on the ticket. Side doors are nicer. Nobody slams a side door.
friendly.hint-cage: Let {mon} smell your hand first. Slowly. There. See? It *knows*.
friendly.pitch-inside: Someone inside wants to help? Oh, that's so brave of them. We have to bring them something.
friendly.pitch-exchange: We give them a thing, they give us our friends. Nobody fights. Can it be that one? Please?
friendly.reunion: They're all here. They're all *here*. Group hug. No, I mean it, everybody in.
friendly.held-too-long: {mon}'s a bit… far away. That's okay. We'll go slowly. We've got time now.
friendly.the-pound: Put me on the cells. I'll sit with them till you're done. I'll tell them you're coming.

bitter.approach: Hey. Got a minute? Don't make it a thing.
bitter.offer: They took {count} of yours. I know what that's like. I've got a way into {site}. Take it or don't.
bitter.pitch-quiet: Quiet's the smart way. Slip in, grab them, slip out. If you can keep your mouth shut.
bitter.pitch-loud: Loud's the satisfying way. We break the door, we break a few faces. They've earned it.
bitter.pitch-deal: Or pay them. I hate that. But it's the one they can't refuse.
bitter.decline: Your call. I'll pretend I never asked.
bitter.start: Stay close. And try not to say anything stupid.
bitter.complication: Of course. Of course something went wrong. Move!
bitter.full: …Got them. All of them. Don't thank me. I mean it.
bitter.partial: Some of them. Not enough. The rest are still in there, and I'm not leaving it like that.
bitter.fail: It's my fault. Don't say otherwise. I'll fix it.
bitter.second-offer: I haven't dropped it. Want a second shot?
bitter.climax-eve: No time left. Tonight they use them, or we do this now. Pick.
bitter.hint-approach: I'll make the noise. You've got the face people open doors for. Use it.
bitter.hint-door: Hinge side. Locks are for people who follow rules.
bitter.hint-cage: Stand in front of them. If one more thing gets taken off somebody today I'm going to break something expensive.
bitter.pitch-inside: You've got a friend on the inside. Course you do. Fine. Use them. Just… make sure they're all right after.
bitter.pitch-exchange: Sell them their own junk back. I like it. I like it a lot.
bitter.held-too-long: They got to {mon}. A little. I know what a little feels like. It'll want you close. Don't crowd it.

scholar.approach: Ah, {player}. Good. I have a proposition, and the data support it.
scholar.offer: Your {count} impounded Pokémon are at {site}. I've observed the place for nine days. I believe I can retrieve them.
scholar.pitch-quiet: Method one: stealth. Fewer observed incidents, longer preparation. It's my preferred method.
scholar.pitch-loud: Method two: direct action. Statistically messier, but faster.
scholar.pitch-deal: Method three: negotiation. Only workable if you can pay. I can supply the argument.
scholar.accept: Excellent. I'll brief you on the way. Take notes. I will.
scholar.decline: Noted. An unexpected decision. I will record it and keep the offer open.
scholar.start: Beginning observation. Please walk where I walk.
scholar.complication: An anomaly. Interesting, and terribly inconvenient.
scholar.full: Success. And a fascinating dataset. They're all yours.
scholar.partial: A partial retrieval. The results are instructive. I propose a follow-up.
scholar.fail: Failure. I underestimated a variable: them. Forgive the error.
scholar.second-offer: I've refined the method. Would you like to review the revision?
scholar.climax-eve: The window closes tonight. I recommend we act, even imperfectly.
scholar.hint-approach: Observation: they change shifts at the quarter hour and nobody watches the gap. We shall be the gap.
scholar.hint-door: The receipt is a primary document. It names a service door. Always read the primary document.
scholar.hint-cage: Recognition precedes trust. Let it identify you. I shall time it, for interest.
scholar.pitch-inside: A primary source! We must not waste a primary source. Also we must keep them safe; I have seen what happens to sources.
scholar.pitch-exchange: An exchange of goods under mutual suspicion. I have read about these. Do not explain the item's value. The books are firm on that.
scholar.reunion: I note elevated vocalisation, physical contact, and what I can only record as joy. Sample size: all of them.
scholar.held-too-long: {mon} presents with a mild Shadow tier. I am recording that as *mild* and *temporary*, and I will be checking on it personally.
scholar.the-pound: The holding site, as a contested district. I should like to hold it. I should like, for once, to be useful rather than informative.

heir.approach: {player}. A word, if you will permit me.
heir.offer: Your Pokémon were taken by {team}. That is a stain upon every trainer in this region. I should like to help remove it.
heir.pitch-quiet: I propose discretion. My family has taught me the use of quiet doors.
heir.pitch-loud: Or a formal assault. It will be noisy, but honourable.
heir.pitch-deal: Or I can see it settled by purse. I would prefer you not owe anyone for it. I will cover the cost.
heir.accept: Thank you. I will not forget the trust.
heir.decline: I understand. My offer remains; do not hesitate to call upon it.
heir.start: We proceed. Remain composed, and I shall do the same.
heir.complication: An unforeseen obstacle. I have faced worse at table. Stay close.
heir.full: It is done. Your Pokémon are returned. It was an honour.
heir.partial: We have recovered some. The rest remain; I will not rest until they are free.
heir.fail: I have failed you. That is not a thing I say lightly.
heir.second-offer: Once more, if you will permit. I have improved the arrangement.
heir.climax-eve: The hour is late. Let us act, or let this stand forever.
heir.hint-approach: We wait for the change of the guard. One does not interrupt.
heir.hint-door: The tradesman's entrance. I am told it is the honest way into any great house.
heir.hint-cage: Allow it to come to you. One does not seize what one has come to restore.
heir.pitch-inside: A friend within. Then we are guests, in a manner of speaking. Let us behave as guests and leave nothing broken that need not be.
heir.pitch-exchange: A formal exchange. I know the customs. Place the article down first; it shows good faith, and it frees both hands.
heir.reunion: They are restored to you. I am… forgive me. I was not taught what to do with my face at such moments.
heir.held-too-long: They have left their mark upon {mon}. I consider it an insult to us both. It will be answered.
heir.the-pound: Assign me the cells. A promise was made concerning them. I intend that it be kept on the field.

lone-wolf.offer: Your Pokémon. {site}. I can get them.

mirror.approach: I was going to find you. Looks like you were going to find me.
mirror.offer: They took {count} of yours. I'd have wanted someone to come for mine. So here I am.
mirror.pitch-quiet: You'd go quiet. You always do. I'd do it your way.
mirror.pitch-loud: Or loud, which is what I'd do if you hadn't gotten there first.
mirror.pitch-deal: Or pay. Which is what neither of us wants, so it's probably right.
mirror.accept: Good. Then we do this the way you'd do it.
mirror.decline: I get it. I'd have said no too. Still here if you change your mind.
mirror.start: Right foot first, same as you. Let's go.
mirror.complication: That's not what you'd have planned for. Me neither.
mirror.full: They're back. I did what you'd have done. Better, maybe? No. Same.
mirror.partial: We got some. You'd say it's good enough for now. I'd say the same.
mirror.fail: That isn't how it was supposed to go. For either of us.
mirror.second-offer: I keep replaying it. Let's try again.
mirror.climax-eve: There's no later left. Whatever you'd do, do it now.
mirror.hint-approach: You'd wait for the shift change. So we wait.
mirror.hint-door: You'd read the ticket twice. I read it twice. There's a side door.
mirror.hint-cage: You'd let it come to you. I'd have grabbed. I'm learning.
mirror.pitch-inside: You've got someone in there who'd open a door for you. I'd like to know what that's like.
mirror.pitch-exchange: A trade. You give up something to get something back. You're better at that than me.
mirror.reunion: They went straight to you. Not a look at me. …Good. That's how it should be.
mirror.held-too-long: {mon} isn't sure which feelings are its own right now. I can sit with it, if you want. I know the way out of that.
mirror.the-pound: You'd want the cells held by someone who knows what it is to be kept. That's me.

beatenToIt.hotshot: A *balloon*? You got rescued by a *balloon*? I had a whole plan! It had a part with a rope!
beatenToIt.prodigy: An external actor resolved it first. I am told this is good news. I am adjusting to that.
beatenToIt.friendly: They're back? Oh, thank goodness. I don't mind who. I mind a *bit*. Mostly I don't mind.
beatenToIt.bitter: Somebody else did it. Faster. …Good. No, I mean it. Good.
beatenToIt.scholar: I had a nine-day observation log. I shall file it under 'unnecessary' and try to feel pleased.
beatenToIt.heir: The matter is settled, and not by me. I shall be gracious about it. Starting presently.
beatenToIt.mirror: Someone got there before me. That's usually your line.

froze.hotshot: A Pokémon of the same species as their starter, much smaller, in a cage that is too big
froze.prodigy: A cage with nothing in it and scratch marks on the inside
froze.friendly: All of it. They are fine. They need a second
froze.bitter: A cage tag with a sponsor's logo on it. A sponsor that turned them down
froze.scholar: A clipboard with someone else's notes. The handwriting is neat. The notes are about pain thresholds
froze.heir: Their family's crest, stamped on the lock
froze.lone-wolf: Nothing visible. They stand there for five seconds, and then carry on
froze.mirror: Their own reflection in the glass, with a Pokémon behind it looking back

receipts.rocket: A numbered claim ticket, carbon copy. "Property held pending assessment. No refunds.
receipts.rocket-returns: A request slip from a radio station: "Your dedication has been received and will be played shortly.
receipts.aqua: A cargo tag, damp. A berth number and a tide table
receipts.magma: A sample label: specimen, mass, temperature tolerance
receipts.galactic: A form with every field filled in except *Owner*
receipts.plasma: A certificate of liberation, gilt-edged, congratulating the Pokémon
receipts.flare: An invoice. The amount is the Pokémon. It is marked *paid*
receipts.skull: A tag sprayed on the nearest wall: the Pokémon's name, spelled wrong, and "BORROWED
receipts.aether: An intake card with a photograph, a habitat number and visiting hours
receipts.macro-cosmos: A lanyard pass for the Pokémon: "Contractor, Energy Division
receipts.yell: A ticket stub. Standing section. "See you at the match!
receipts.star: A sticky note: "Borrowing this. Sorry. Will give back. Probably.
receipts.rocket-remnants: An IOU, signed by all three, with a pawprint
receipts.snagem: Nothing. That is how the player knows who it was

rocket.assigned: *Tagged*: cannot be forced to switch out; the tag can be removed at any rest node

rocket-returns.assigned: Flinches at radio static: −1 Speed on its first turn in the next battle only

aqua.assigned: +1 Speed in rain, −1 in harsh sun, for five nodes

magma.assigned: +1 Defense in harsh sun, −1 in rain, for five nodes

galactic.assigned: *Quiet*: bond effects are halved for five nodes. It comes back to itself gradually

plasma.assigned: Hesitates once (loses one turn in its next battle) the first time it is sent out

flare.assigned: Keeps the ribbon: a harmless held item

skull.processed: A sprayed tag on one flank
skull.assigned: Has picked up a bad habit: uses its weakest move first, once. The Grunts taught it that for a laugh

aether.assigned: Cannot be given a status condition for five nodes; −1 Speed for the same

macro-cosmos.assigned: Tired: starts its next battle at 90% HP. It has been working

yell.assigned: Louder: its sound-based moves have +10% power for five nodes. It had a lovely time
yell.heldTooLong: Never. Yell binds nothing; the Pokémon comes back hoarse

star.assigned: Nothing. Somebody fed it and taught it a trick

rocket-remnants.assigned: Nothing. Meowth kept it company and it is slightly spoiled

snagem.assigned: *Snagged*: 20% chance to skip a turn in its next battle, once, looking for its trainer

sites.name: Team Rocket
sites.note: Numbered cages under the Game Corner
sites.approach: Down the Game Corner's back stairs, past a poster that is a switch
sites.door: A numbered grille; the number on the claim ticket opens it
sites.cage: Rows of cages with claim numbers
sites.jailerLine: Ticket? No ticket, no talk. Ticket, we talk.

sites.name: Rocket Returns
sites.approach: Through the souvenir shop, under the Ragecandybar display
sites.door: A studio door with a red light. It cannot be opened while the light is on
sites.cage: Pens beside the transmitter. The hum makes teeth ache
sites.jailerLine: station manager". "We're on air in two minutes. Whatever this is, make it one.

sites.name: Team Aqua
sites.approach: Along the dry dock at low tide
sites.cage: Tanks and net cages, half flooded on a schedule
sites.jailerLine: Tide's in at six. You want 'em dry, you want 'em before six.

sites.name: Team Magma
sites.approach: Down a service tunnel that is slightly too warm
sites.door: A blast door with a thermal lock: it opens when the room is cool
sites.jailerLine: Don't touch the lamps. They like the lamps. I'm fairly sure they like the lamps.

sites.name: Team Galactic
sites.approach: The lift does not list this floor
sites.door: A door with no handle on the outside
sites.cage: Chain-linked cages in a room with no echo
sites.jailerLine: I am required to ask your business. I am not required to care.

sites.name: Team Plasma
sites.door: A hold hatch with a banner over it: *They Are Free Now*
sites.cage: A large, comfortable pen with no exit
sites.jailerLine: You've come to take them back into bondage. I shall pray for you. The key is on the hook.

sites.name: Team Flare
sites.cage: Sterile glass cases, each with a price card
sites.jailerLine: They are very well kept. Better than you kept them, I think. Look at the coat.

sites.name: Team Skull
sites.approach: Over the Po Town wall, in the rain
sites.door: A door held shut by a Grunt leaning on it
sites.cage: A cellar. Someone has put down blankets
sites.jailerLine: Boss said nobody goes in. He didn't say nothin' about *out*. Hm.

sites.name: Aether Foundation
sites.approach: The visitors' entrance, during visiting hours
sites.door: A habitat airlock with a sanitising cycle
sites.cage: Glass habitats, each one perfect and sealed
sites.jailerLine: Visiting hours end at four. You're welcome to look. Please don't tap the glass.

sites.name: Macro Cosmos
sites.approach: A staff corridor; the lanyard pass from the receipt works once
sites.cage: Dynamax chambers: red light under the doors
sites.jailerLine: If it's on the rota I can't release it. If you take it off the rota I never saw it on the rota.

sites.name: Team Yell
sites.site: The Spikemuth fan hall back room
sites.door: It is open. It is always open
sites.cage: A back room with sofas. The Pokémon are watching a match replay
sites.jailerLine: Oh! They're yours? We thought they were supporters! They've been *brilliant*.

sites.name: Team Star
sites.door: A padlock with the code written on it in marker
sites.cage: Starmobile crates with air holes and cushions
sites.jailerLine: We were gonna give them back! We got busy! There was a *thing*!

sites.name: Rocket Remnants
sites.site: Their hideout in the host region (default: Route 9 depot, back lot)
sites.approach: Their hideout in the host region
sites.door: A net, strung across the doorway, that falls on whoever sets it
sites.cage: A cage made of other, smaller cages
sites.jailerLine: Youse can't prove nothin'. …How much ya got?

sites.name: Team Snag'em
sites.site: Their hideout in the host region (default: the Unova shipyard)
sites.approach: Their hideout in the host region
sites.door: A roller shutter and a dog that is actually a Houndour
sites.cage: Dark cages. The Pokémon inside have gone quiet
sites.jailerLine: …Take them. Quick. I'm going to go and check on something over there for five minutes.

complications.name: The Extra Guard
complications.sees: Someone who was not on the rival's map
complications.good: Wait: they are on a break and will leave

complications.name: The Wrong Cage
complications.sees: The cage number on the receipt holds a different Pokémon
complications.good: Open it anyway, then find the right one

complications.name: Moved
complications.sees: The Pokémon were moved an hour ago

complications.name: The Alarm Test
complications.good: Walk, do not run: it is only a test

complications.name: It Won't Come
complications.sees: The player's Pokémon is frightened and will not leave the cage
complications.good: Sit down. Wait. Say its name

complications.name: The Friendly Grunt
complications.sees: A Grunt who has been feeding them and does not want trouble

complications.name: The Second Rescuer
complications.sees: Somebody else is already breaking in for their own Pokémon

complications.name: Locked In
complications.sees: The door shuts behind the party
complications.good: Look up: there is always a hatch

complications.name: The Officer
complications.sees: A Lieutenant arrives for an inspection
complications.good: Hide among the cages. The Pokémon keep quiet for the player

complications.name: The Paperwork
complications.sees: The jailer will not release them without a form
complications.good: Fill in the form. It is two lines long

complications.name: Somebody's Missing
complications.sees: One of the impounded Pokémon is not with the others
complications.good: Ask the others. One of them points

complications.name: The Rival Freezes
complications.sees: The rival sees something in a cage that stops them

summaryLines.logged: It checked that you were all still here.
summaryLines.processed: It keeps looking at the mark they left. It doesn't seem to mind when you look too.
summaryLines.assigned: It did what they told it. It would rather not talk about it.
summaryLines.held-too-long: It knows you came. It took a while to be sure.
